summary: Enum constants. CONST_DB_PROVIDER_TYPE (20 providers) is the provider key used by settings specs, auth adapters and the connection factory. The module also defines IBIS_DB_CONNECTION_MODE, auth-method, SSL-mode, connection-status, pool-mode, backend-name, Ibis URL-prefix, file-capability, index-type and conflict-action enums that no source or test module imports.
extension_points: Adding a backend requires a new CONST_DB_PROVIDER_TYPE member referenced by its BackendSpec and auth adapters.
lifecycle_notes: No Iceberg/PyIceberg members remain after the Iceberg retirement.
documentation_hooks: Reference table of CONST_DB_PROVIDER_TYPE members and their settings classes.
risks: Eleven of the twelve enums have no importer in src or tests; only CONST_DB_PROVIDER_TYPE is load-bearing. dialects/_registry.py duplicates IBIS_DB_CONNECTION_MODE values as local constants instead of importing them.
Header comment `#path: mountainash_data/databases/constants.py` names a path that no longer exists.
open_questions: Should the unused enums (CONST_DB_AUTH_METHOD, SSL modes, CONST_DB_BACKEND, CONST_DB_BACKEND_IBIS_PREFIX, capabilities, pool/status, index type, conflict action) be removed or documented as public constants?

evidence.detail: Line 734 mirrors IBIS_DB_CONNECTION_MODE as local constants
Twelve enum classes; grep shows no importer for eleven of them
